parsed.summary: All edits strictly conform to the approved PLAN-B77 specifications. In `jobs.py`, `recent()` safely consumes lines using `collections.deque(maxlen=n)` preventing excessive memory use on long logs, and `on_boot()` correctly analyzes up to 2000 lines to detect interrupted jobs while pruning the persistent log to 300 entries. In `chip_course.py`, SQLite connection lifetime is properly guarded with `try...finally` in `run_all()`, preventing connection/file descriptor leaks, and error reporting via `last_errors` cleanly surfaces failures per strategy. No regressions, deadlocks, or unhandled edge cases detected.
parsed.coverage: Inspected jobs.py (process-wide RLock concurrency, memory sampling, deque-based recent reading, atomic boot log rotation, on_boot crash detection) and chip_course.py (connection lifecycle management, SQLite query safety, exception handling, data parsing, division-by-zero guards, and screener edge cases).
parsed.limitations: Static code analysis of provided files; live TWSE/TPEx/TDCC HTTP API endpoint connectivity was not tested dynamically during this inspection.
